entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, I need to make a return for a VeloBand Pulse I bought.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Linda. I can definitely help you with that. Do you have your order number handy?
Great, let me pull that up... VF908-121525. Okay, I see the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered on December 15th. Let's see...
Okay, looks like you are well within the 90 days for our return window, so that is absolutely no problem. I can process this for you right away.
Oh, that's great. I wasn't sure what the policy was for these new bands.

Not to worry! And I see here that you're a VIP member with us. I've already waived the return shipping fee and I'm emailing you the pre-paid return label as we speak. You should see it in your inbox shortly.
Wow, thank you so much. That was easy.

Of course! Just print that return label, attach it to the original box, and you can drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. Thanks for your help, Linda.
You're very welcome. Thank you for being a VeloFit VIP, and have a great day!
